purpose: Empirically calibrated Small/Medium instance sets for the computational study comparing MiniZinc (exact) with LNS. The sets are based on measured wall-clock cost (translation + solve with cp-sat, capping solve at 20 s) on the reference machine. IMPORTANT: DSL->MiniZinc translation is the dominant cost (deepcopy blow-up in the translator's loop unrolling); a 10x10 JSSP takes ~600 s just to translate, and 2dbp n>=30 is infeasible. Instances are listed only if translation completes in a practical budget.
measured_environment: cp-sat 9.15 (via --params max_time_in_seconds), MiniZinc 2.10.1, uv venv python 3.11, Windows.

measurement_notes.translation_is_bottleneck: translation time is the binding constraint: cvrp15=29.7s, jssp 10x5=13.5s, jssp 10x10=607s, 2dbp n=20=45-90s, 2dbp n=30=>4min.
measurement_notes.proves_within_budget: only tiny instances reach proof: cvrp8 (2.0s total, optimal), jssp 2x2 (0.2s), jssp 5x4 (0.8s).
measurement_notes.medium_definition: Medium = translates within budget and gives a feasible incumbent (SAT) but does NOT prove optimality within the solve budget; this is the meaningful regime for the MiniZinc-vs-LNS gap study.

small.meaning: translates fast, MiniZinc can prove optimality in budget

medium.meaning: translates within budget, gives incumbent but no proof (MiniZinc-vs-LNS gap regime)

cvrp.lns_only_note: Golden (201-483 cities) and E-n22+ translate too slowly for the exact baseline; keep only for the LNS side of the study.

small.meaning: translates fast, MiniZinc proves optimality in budget

medium.meaning: 10x5 JSSP: translates within budget, gives incumbent (SAT) but no proof; top of feasible exact range

jssp.lns_only_note: 10x10 JSSP (la16-20: 607s translate) and anything larger (ta, swv, abz7+) is translation-infeasible for the exact baseline; keep for LNS only.

small.meaning: n=20 loose boxes; translates in ~45-50s and completes within budget (incumbent, no proof)

medium.meaning: n=20 tighter boxes; translates in 47-90s, up to the practical translation limit

2dbp.lns_only_note: n>=30 (the size-scaled generated set) is translation-infeasible (>4min just to translate); the generator Tools/generate_2dbp_instances.py remains useful once the translator is optimized.
